item.title: Why Voters Delivered the Blue Tsunami, the Shocking Dem Margins, and the WORST New Senators, with RealClearPolitics | Ep. 1434 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly discusses the anger from voters on display last night, how the Iran War, Epstein, and data centers helped to bring about blue tsunami, the fallout from the broken Trump promises seen in the midterm election results, VP JD Vance being brutally honest about the reason so many Trump 2024 voters turned to the Democrats in 2026, the four reasons he laid out about why the GOP lost so badly, and more. Then Tom Bevan, Carl Cannon, and Andrew Walworth of RealClearPolitics join to discuss why the GOP might even lose a senate seat in Mississippi, how Trump’s focus on issues like the name of the Kennedy Center and “Super Intelligence” relate to the blue tsunami, how Ron DeSantis is sounding like he’s running for president, why opposing grift and corruption is a winning message going into 2028, the shocking margin of victory for Democrats across the country, how James Talarico somehow won Texas by 12 points, how Democratic Senate candidate Scott Colom won over the deep red state of Mississippi, the effective ads from him that show why he might be about to win, why Abdul El-Sayed’s victory speech shows why he’s a pr*ck, which new Dem senator will be the worst, and more.
